data.description: Wave 2, depends on the dispatcher extraction. SPEC IDs: COR-1..COR-4. Empty/absent surface refs on all surface-scoped writes rejected with clear errors, never defaulted to the focused surface (June audit P0); skill footgun guidance updated. Main-thread-reachable socket paths eliminated: pane.confirm, feedback.submit, nested CFRunLoopRun genre swept fresh; hang monitor clean under a scripted C11-156-shaped hook/telemetry flood. Regression tests for both genres. Contract: docs/cycles/2026-07-truth-and-stability/ (SPEC.md, EVALUATION.md, BUILDPLAN.md). Validation bar: tagged build + recorded scenario proof.
data.title: P0 correctness: empty-ref rejection everywhere, main-thread socket paths eliminated

data.note: Wave 2 builds on the extracted dispatcher base

data.body: PLAN (planned): COR-1 rejects empty/absent surface refs on all 10 write commands (set-metadata/agent/title/description/status/progress, log, rename-tab, clear-metadata, trigger-flash) via one pure, logic-testable validator (SocketSurfaceRefValidator, mirroring SocketMetadataSourceValidator) wired into the three real transports — v2 surface/pane metadata resolvers, the v2 tab-action resolver, and the v1 sidebar-metadata resolver — removing the ?? focusedPanelId fallback on write paths only (strict: gate so query/focus/split keep theirs), plus CLI defense-in-depth against exported-empty CMUX_SURFACE_ID. COR-2 rewrites the SKILL.md:36 footgun (errors loudly now, no silent misroute) + sync-installed-skills. COR-3 fixes pane.confirm/feedback.submit/browser-await by moving them onto the socket-worker execution policy so their already-present off-main branch runs instead of the main.sync/nested-CFRunLoopRun path; browser slice is the risk (minimal fallback documented). COR-4: logic-suite empty-ref test on the validator seam + tests_v2 socket-flood liveness test that reddens if main-thread sync work returns. Validation: tagged build cor-post + recorded empty-ref-rejection and flood-liveness proofs, hang.log clean. Full plan in plans/task_01KWX7GBZZ88Z0PMJH2NT0KCPQ.md.

PLAN-REVIEW CYCLE 1 COMPLETE (authoritative amendment §8 appended). NOTE for orchestrator: the board's auto triple/trident plan-review could NOT spawn — it opens an interactive c11 pane and failed twice (first 'Failed to write to socket', then 'pane_too_small' in the review workspace DB29BC45); LATTICE_SPAWN_BACKEND=headless is not honored by the plan-review path. I re-ran --mode inline (self-review) and supplemented with 3 independent read-only review agents (correctness/threading/test lenses). They found load-bearing defects, all resolved in §8: (COR-1) v1 set-status/set-progress/log actually route through resolveTabForReport ?? selectedTabId (tab-scoped), NOT the closure first named — fix retargeted; validator requiredAnyOf narrowed to the granularity-pinning key so a --workspace-only ref can't still misroute; strict: resolver param dropped (validator-at-entry suffices, ~45 callers untouched). (COR-3) the nonisolated+v2MainSync pattern does NOT compile (v2MainSync is @MainActor) — real pattern is Task{@MainActor}+semaphore, so each moved handler is a rewrite: feedback.submit clean, pane.confirm a real rewrite. **SCOPE FORK FOR ORCHESTRATOR:** moving the browser blocking commands off-main would call WebKit off-thread → crash worse than the current hang, and activates the P1.4 per-surface-dict race. Recommended: do the correct full fix (worker policy + marshal every WebKit start-closure to main + serialize the dicts) to keep the nested-CFRunLoopRun genre eliminated per SPEC; if it exceeds the fix-cycle budget, split browser to a follow-on ticket with a v2AwaitCallback hardening guard, landing pane.confirm+feedback.submit now. (COR-4) tests_v2 is NOT in GitHub CI — 'CI socket lane' claim retracted; flood test retargeted to the c11-vm + recorded tagged-build artifact, made fail-not-skip; a handler-driving reject test made mandatory in hosted c11Tests (CI-gated), pure-seam test in c11LogicTests (confirmed buildable via BUNDLE_LOADER). Holding at planned, awaiting RESUME IMPLEMENTATION with worktree.

Plan revalidated against merged origin/main (16c9c2d2a). Every anchor the plan (incl. §8 amendment) depends on is at its planned location — the merged C11-159 preserved the extraction-branch layout verbatim (v2String:2434, socketWorkerV2Methods:1901, v2ResolveSurfaceForMetadata:1306, v2PaneConfirm:PaneHandlers884, v2FeedbackSubmit:MarkdownFeedbackHandlers56, resolveTabForReport:7077→?? selectedTabId, v2TabAction:MiscHandlers57, SocketMetadataSourceValidator precedent present). No architectural drift; no plan-review re-run needed. Proceeding to implementation in worktree cor-p0-correctness, starting with COR-1 (SocketSurfaceRefValidator + reject-at-entry).

COR-1 + COR-2 landed (commit 092855747): empty/absent-ref rejection wired into all v2 write handlers (surface/pane metadata, trigger_flash, rename) + v1 sidebar writes (set_status/set_progress/log), via the pure SocketSurfaceRefValidator seam + a resolvability guard. c11-logic build green, 11/11 logic tests pass. Skill footgun rewritten + sync-installed-skills run. Host wiring test added. Next: COR-3 (main-thread socket paths).

FLAG (base health, not COR-caused): c11Tests/SurfaceActivityTests.swift does NOT compile on merged origin/main (16c9c2d2a) — TimeInterval? vs TimeInterval at lines 35/46/62/64 (XCTAssertEqual(read?.timeIntervalSince1970, ..., accuracy:) — read is Date?). Pre-existing (last touched by c8eb1032f/C11-24, an ancestor of main; I have zero diff to it; it's SurfaceActivityTracker/RES domain). Effect: the whole c11-unit HOST test target won't compile, so my COR-4 host wiring test (SocketSurfaceRefRejectionWiringTests) can't RUN there until the base compiles — though it builds/links fine. c11-logic (fast suite) is unaffected and green. COR-1 wiring is being validated instead via the tests_v2 socket matrix against the tagged build. Flagging for orchestrator/RES to fix the base host-suite compile (affects every Wave 2 host-test validation).

Validation done on tagged cor-post: COR-1 empty-ref socket matrix PASS (all 6 v2 write methods reject empty_ref/missing_ref, no write lands, workspace-only doesn't misroute, positive control OK); COR-3 flood liveness PASS (31 probes, worst 37ms « 2s), pane.confirm off-main PASS (752ms probe vs ~3000ms freeze if on-main), hang.log clean for the app pid; c11-logic 11/11. NOTE: the auto headless code-review returned an empty diff (it ran against the parent checkout on main, not the worktree branch) — using own-reviewer fallback per boot: 2 independent review agents + self-review on the worktree diff (16 files, +819/-55). Triaging their findings before push.

COMPLETE → pr_open. PR #319 (ts/cor-p0-correctness → main, 3 commits): https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/319 — OPERATOR MERGES. Summary: COR-1 empty/absent surface-ref rejection wired into all v2 write handlers + v1 sidebar writes + the 5 CLI write sugars (server-authoritative + CLI client-side fallback closed) via the pure SocketSurfaceRefValidator seam; COR-2 skill footgun rewritten + synced; COR-3 pane.confirm/feedback.submit moved off-main (worker policy + Task{@MainActor} pattern), browser nested-CFRunLoopRun wedge fixed in-place (WebKit stays on main); COR-4 logic suite (11/11, CI-gated) + host wiring test + 3 tests_v2 socket tests (fail-not-skip). Validated on tagged cor-post: empty-ref matrix, CLI scrubbed-env rejection, flood liveness (34ms), pane.confirm off-main — all PASS; hang.log clean; build (app+CLI) SUCCEEDED. Review: own-reviewer fallback (auto code-review saw empty diff on the parent checkout) — 2 independent reviewers, 2 HIGH + 1 MED fixed (triage attached --role review). FLAGS: (1) pre-existing base break c11Tests/SurfaceActivityTests.swift blocks the c11-unit host lane (RES domain); (2) deliberate behavior change — ref-less external writes now error (skill updated). Stopping per Wave-2 barrier.
